questions.question: When constructing a Beverage antenna, which of the following factors should be included in the design to achieve good performance at the desired frequency?

choices.A: Its overall length must not exceed 1/4 wavelength
choices.B: It must be mounted more than 1 wavelength above ground
choices.C: It should be configured as a four-sided loop
choices.D: It should be at least one wavelength long

questions.answer: It should be at least one wavelength long

questions.question: Which is generally true for 160- and 80-meter receiving antennas?

choices.A: Atmospheric noise is so high that directivity is much more important than losses
choices.B: They must be erected at least 1/2 wavelength above the ground to attain good directivity
choices.C: Low loss coax transmission line is essential for good performance

questions.answer: Atmospheric noise is so high that directivity is much more important than losses

questions.question: What is receiving directivity factor (RDF)?

choices.A: Forward gain compared to the gain in the reverse direction
choices.C: Relative directivity compared to a dipole
choices.D: Peak antenna gain compared to average gain over the hemisphere around and above the antenna

questions.answer: Peak antenna gain compared to average gain over the hemisphere around and above the antenna

questions.question: What is the purpose of placing an electrostatic shield around a small-loop direction-finding antenna?

choices.A: It adds capacitive loading, increasing the bandwidth of the antenna
choices.B: It eliminates unbalanced capacitive coupling to the antenna’s surroundings, improving the depth of its nulls
choices.C: It eliminates tracking errors caused by strong out-of-band signals
choices.D: It increases signal strength by providing a better match to the feed line

questions.answer: It eliminates unbalanced capacitive coupling to the antenna’s surroundings, improving the depth of its nulls

questions.question: What challenge is presented by a small wire-loop antenna for direction finding?

choices.A: It has a bidirectional null pattern
choices.B: It does not have a clearly defined null
choices.C: It is practical for use only on VHF and higher bands

questions.answer: It has a bidirectional null pattern

questions.question: What indicates the correct value of terminating resistance for a Beverage antenna?

choices.A: Maximum feed point DC resistance at the center of the desired frequency range
choices.B: Minimum low-angle front-to-back ratio at the design frequency
choices.C: Maximum DC current in the terminating resistor
choices.D: Minimum variation in SWR over the desired frequency range

questions.answer: Minimum variation in SWR over the desired frequency range

questions.question: What is the function of a Beverage antenna’s termination resistor?

choices.B: Absorb signals from the reverse direction

questions.answer: Absorb signals from the reverse direction

questions.question: What is the function of a sense antenna?

choices.A: It modifies the pattern of a DF antenna to provide a null in only one direction
choices.B: It increases the sensitivity of a DF antenna array
choices.C: It allows DF antennas to receive signals at different vertical angles
choices.D: It provides diversity reception that cancels multipath signals

questions.answer: It modifies the pattern of a DF antenna to provide a null in only one direction

questions.question: What type of radiation pattern is created by a single-turn, terminated loop such as a pennant antenna?
How can the output voltage of a multiple-turn receiving loop antenna be increased?

choices.A: By reducing the permeability of the loop shield
choices.B: By utilizing high impedance wire for the coupling loop
choices.C: By increasing the number of turns and/or the area enclosed by the loop

questions.answer: By increasing the number of turns and/or the area enclosed by the loop
